_about: Snapshot of understudy_engine.cue.score.growth() through routes._meta, on the engine's own test learners (seed 7 and 3). Used by engine-contract.test.ts to catch drift in the response shape.

meta.note: Independence is the share of the last 20 occurrences finished with no accepted cue, with its Wilson interval. The composite uses stated, unfitted weights; read the components. Delegated and automation work is not counted.

score.composite_caveat: Experimental. In testing it overstated by 6 to 10 points when nobody improved, and rose 10 points or more in 33% of learners whose skill never changed. Read the trend and the independence interval instead.

mastery.note: From the tracing replay. On generated learners who did not improve it overstated mastery by 0.3 to 0.5, so it is not used in any headline.

trend.power_note: In simulation, a steady fall in the share of occurrences that needed help from 0.5 to 0.2 was picked up by this test in about 3 of 10 learners at 120 occurrences, and in fewer than 5 of 10 even at 360, so a steady reading means cannot tell yet, never no change. The independence interval and the first-versus-latest counts say more.

time_to_progress.note: Seconds from the first cue to the next progress event. Live data has no no-cue counterfactual; the simulator pairs them.
